In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the OM in the lacustrine sediment of plateau lakes is mainly composed of aquatic OM.
the sedimentary OM in northwestern and southwestern Chinese plateau lakes are dominated by terrestrial and aquatic OM, respectively.
the OM sources in plateau lakes are mainly of terrestrial origin.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the distribution of OM in the surface sediments from the six plateau lakes in northwestern and southwestern China was controlled by both primary and secondary sources.
the distribution of OM in lacustrine sedments was controlled by the input of OM and its degradation in the sediments.
the OM of the plateau lakes in China was dominated by terrestrial OM, with the exception of a few lakes in southwestern China that were affected by anthropogenic activities.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the distribution and sources and of organic matter in the sediments are influenced by the hydrological and climatic conditions of each lake.
the distribution patterns of n-alkanals and FAs are influenced by the source of the OM and the degree of post-depositional alteration.
the sources of organic matter and the distribution of organic carbon and nitrogen in surface lacustrine sedments from plateau lakes are influenced by both the local climate and human activities.
